name: Codex CLI
desc_zh: Apache-2.0 协议的开源终端编程智能体。
solves: An AI that edits code never sees your project layout and won't run what it changed. This one reads and writes inside your repo, from the terminal.
solves_zh: 让 AI 改代码，它看不见你的项目结构，改完也不敢跑。这个开源助手在终端里直接进你的仓库读写。
best_for: You want an agent to change code in a repository you actually control.
best_for_zh: 你想让智能体在你真正掌控的仓库里动手改代码。
